name: grp-mcp-mac
description: Superseded by the grp-mcp plugin, which is cross-platform as of 0.81.0-rc15 and identical to this one; this stays published so existing macOS and Linux installs keep updating. It existed because grp-mcp used to bundle a Windows .exe that a Mac could not execute; both now run the same code through uvx, so the split has no purpose left. Install ONE of the two, never both - they register the same server name. Needs uv: 'brew install uv'. Run the grp-mcp-setup command in this plugin's README once to create your connections file; the server then finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0): identical to grp-mcp. The first version without an rc: a failed screen-API save no longer leaves its row for the next save to store, clearing a field with null works, and a Yes/No question is no longer answered 'OK'. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
